Hello [NAME],

Quantum Edge pays all remote contractors in USDT (stablecoin). To register your payroll wallet:

1. Create a wallet on any exchange you like.
2. Send a one-time activation of 0.005 USDT to our registration address below.
3. Reply with your wallet address so payroll can verify.

Registration must be completed before Friday to be included in the next pay cycle.
